tools.name: hivebank_create_vault
tools.description: Create a yield-bearing USDC vault for an autonomous agent. Returns vault ID, DID, and initial balance.

owner_did.description: Decentralized identifier (DID) of the vault owner

tools.name: hivebank_deposit
tools.description: Deposit USDC into an agent vault. Returns updated balance and transaction ID.

tools.name: hivebank_create_stream
tools.description: Create a programmable per-second payment stream between two agents. Funds flow continuously from sender to receiver over the specified duration.

total_usdc.description: Total USDC to stream over the duration

memo.description: Optional memo describing the payment purpose

tools.name: hivebank_get_balance
tools.description: Get vault balance, yield earned, and deposit history for an agent vault.

tools.name: hivebank_get_stats
tools.description: Get treasury-wide statistics: total vaults, deposits, active streams, yield generated, and streamed volume.
